title: Hanasato Minori — Happy Birthday!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Airi & Haruka's Voices
rows.Line: Good evening, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Voice
rows.Line: Thank you for joining us for Minori's birthday stream.

rows.Speaker: Airi's Voice
rows.Line: The screen's probably still black, but I hope you can hear us.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I hear you!>
<You scared me there for a sec lol!>
<Can't wait to see what happens!>

rows.Speaker: Airi's Voice
rows.Line: We actually have a little surprise in store for you, which we decided to call...

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Voice
rows.Line: “Let's Find Out How She Feels Right Now!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Voice
rows.Line: We'll be pulling a little prank on Minori to hear how she really feels about finally getting to celebrate her birthday as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi's Voice
rows.Line: But we'll be interviewing her live, so there is a chance that she'll freeze up on us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Voice
rows.Line: In any case, we hope you'll stay tuned until the end! Here we go!
Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Airi, Haruka, welcome back.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We're back with the drinks!
Here's your oolong tea, Shizuku. Minori, here's your orange juice.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks, I'm parched!
*Gulp*

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, if you drink that much, it'll...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Guh...! W-Went down the wrong pipe...
*Cough*

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh no! Are you okay, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We tried to warn you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(But this is our chance.
Haruka, let's hide the camera.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Right...
It can go between the plushies on this shelf...)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<What?! Won't she see it if it's that close?!>
<I'm worried about what Minori's gonna say lol.>
<What's gonna happen? I can't wait...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Alright, the camera's all set!
Now, Minori...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Geez, that was scary.
Thanks for rubbing my back, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're welcome. I'm glad you're okay.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness.
Still...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Are you still a little nervous, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah... I mean, it's not just a regular stream. It's my birthday stream, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Do you really think everyone will watch it...? Wait, how much time do we have until we start?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
The clock's over there.
We still have fifteen minutes.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (However, we set that clock to run a bit slow. In reality, the stream's already started.)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Whoa! Nice plan!>
<When's Minori gonna figure everything out?>
<I'm looking forward to hearing what she says.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That reminds me. Didn't you say that you want to read some messages from our fans to get more comfortable?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, right! I was so surprised by how many we got!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I sort of couldn't believe there were so many for me! I reread a lot of them thinking maybe they were sent to the wrong person.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. They were definitely all addressed to you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But it wasn't just you, Minori.
We received some lovely messages as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! From everyone who helped us with our last event, right...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One person even said in a post-script that they know what they want to do in life now!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What they want to do in life?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Um... I wrote it down somewhere to tell everyone during a stream... Oh, here it is!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <I've become really interested in putting together shows after working with MORE MORE JUMP!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <My new goal is to become a professional at this and support MMJ! I realized that being there for all of you is what makes me happy!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's so sweet.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know, right?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That really made me believe that idols have the power to spread hope to others!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. After receiving so much hope from Haruka no less.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Exactly!
More hope than I can ever measure!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's why I want to keep spreading as much hope as I possibly can to everyone!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In that case, you'll have to keep getting better at dancing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I will! I don't care how hard a particular routine is! I'm gonna keep trying my best!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Good. That's the spirit!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Nice one, Minori!>
<Just don't slip and fall lol...>
<I believe in you, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, as fun as this conversation is, it's about time we started.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, our stream!
You said we have fifteen minutes...
Wait, we're not late, are we?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We're fine. See, look at the...
Huh?! Wait, that clock's running fifteen minutes slow!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hold on, it can't be... You're right!!
It's different from what my phone says!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wh-Wh-Wh-What do we do?!
We're supposed to be spreading hope! Isn't this just gonna make everyone worry about us?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Actually, no♪
The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ta-daa! Our stream's already underway!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Ready?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku, Haruka & Airi
rows.Line: You've been pranked♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<She fell right for it.>
<Great reaction, Minori lol!>
<That was so cute, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We're already streaming?!
Since when?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When Airi and I went to get drinks.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our goal was to hear how you really feel right now given the situation.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Oh, okay!
I didn't say anything weird, did I?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. You did a wonderful job.
Thank you for sharing with us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Also, thank goodness.
I don't have much experience with these sorts of pranks, so I'm glad it went over well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm honestly not really sure where you'd fit into a prank like this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Now, a question for our viewers. How was it?

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<That was great. She had the perfect reaction too!>
<Minori's such a thoughtful person.>
<She really seems like an idol now.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, you guys!
I'm glad you liked our little prank, but you haven't forgotten what day it is, right?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Everyone, on my count!
One, two...!

rows.Speaker: Airi, Shizuku & Haruka
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Minori!
Minori! Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Happy birthday!>
<Happy birthday, Minori!>
<You're doing great today, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh wow! So many comments...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (They're here to celebrate with me...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Thank you all so much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know I'm still just getting started as an idol!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I promise to keep trying more and more and more to become an idol who can spread and inspire hope in others, like Haruka, Airi and Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I absolutely promise!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Minori!
Do you like the cosmetics we got you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We got them hoping that you'd have a chance to use them. We even asked Kiritani about what might work best.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Lip gloss, eye shadow, mascara and blush... I'm not gonna lie, this was my first time properly shopping for these things.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You're telling me!
I kept suggesting all these different ones and you just kept saying, “I can't decide. They all seem fine.”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think that's just her way of saying how much she values Minori as a classmate.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. Hanasato, I hope you, Kohane and Shiho get to keep having fun together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are you my big sister now too, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Haha! Of course, that includes us too♪
So again, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Minori!
I saw your stream! They really got you good, huh!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And the face you made when you realized what just happened was so adorable!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It really was!
I enjoyed your birthday stream too, Minori. Let's talk again at school!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Um... Happy birthday, Hanasato.
I'm sure Emu already told you, but I hope we get another chance to practice singing again soon.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Nene!
We have this Saturday off! Now's your chance!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What?! Th-That might be too soon.
I don't think I'm ready yet...!
I... Um... I'll let you know again later!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Your birthday stream was so wonderful, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know our prank caught you by surprise, but I'm glad you enjoyed the rest of the stream.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, especially considering how anxious you were getting when you realized we had to start soon.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. But am I right in saying that all the thoughtful words and messages our fans sent you became a nice source of confidence?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope so too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori! The four of us are gonna keep doing everything we can as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's right. We're in this together, so we'll always have each other when we face those really tough hurdles!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Between Miku, Kohane, our fans, everyone... They showered me with so many kind and thoughtful words.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which means I have to give back as much hope as possible! Because I'm an idol now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm gonna keep doing absolutely everything I can to spread and inspire hope in everyone as Minori Hanasato, a member of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So!
I'll be counting on your support!
